src: also I was the point person on my company's transition from the KL-5 to GR-6 system.
ref: 另外，我还负责公司里KL5系统转换到GR6系统的工作。

src: You must've had your hands full.
That I did. That I did.
So let's talk a little bit about your duties.
ref: 我们来谈谈你的职责吧。

src: My duties? All right.
Now you'll be heading a whole division, so you'll have a lot of duties.
ref: 你将负责一整个部门，所以你要担负起很多职责。

src: I see.
But there'll be perhaps 30 people under you so you can dump a certain amount on them.
ref: 你手下会有31个人，你可以把很多工作分配给他们。

src: Good to know.
We can go into detail
No don't I beg of you!
All right then, we'll have a definite answer for you on Monday, but I think I can say with some confidence, you'll fit in well here.
ref: 好吧，我们会在星期一回复你，但我相信你能很好地融入公司环境。

src: Really?!
Absolutely. You can relax. You did great.
ref: 当然。放轻松，你表现得很好。

src: Hey, Mon.
Hey, hey, hey. You wanna hear something that sucks?
ref: 嗨嗨嗨。想听一件很烂的事吗？

src: Do I ever!
Chris says they're closing down the bar.
ref: 克里斯说酒吧要停业了。

src: No way!
Yeah, apparently they're turning it into some kinda coffee place.
ref: 听说这里要改成一家咖啡馆。

src: Just coffee!Where are we gonna hang out now?
ref: 只卖咖啡！那我们以后去哪里玩？

src: Got me.
Can I get a beer.
Hey, did you pick a roommate?
You betcha!
Is it the Italian guy?
Um-mm, yeah right!
Oh my God, oh my God!Poor Monica!
ref: 我的天，我的天！可怜的莫妮卡！

src: What, what, what?!
What?!
He was with her when he wrote this poem.
ref: 他在跟她亲热时写这首诗。

src: Look, my vessel so empty with nothing inside.
ref: 我的花瓶如此美丽，内里空无一物。

src: Now that I've touched you, you seem emptier still.
ref: 如今我伸手触摸，你看似更加空洞。

src: He thinks Monica is empty, she is the empty vase!
ref: 他觉得莫妮卡很空洞，她是个空花瓶！

src: Oh, totally. Oh, God, oh, she seemed so happy too.
Ameri-can.
Ameri-can. you know it's a very hard language.
Everybody!!
Good job Joe!Well done!Top notch!
ref: 演得好，乔伊！太棒了！超一流！

src: Oh, ho, ho, yeah!
The whole thing!Can we go?
I love the specifics, the specifics were the best part!
ref: 我就喜欢具体细节，细节处理得最棒了！

src: I was surprised to see a kangaroo in a World War I epic.
ref: 我吓了一大跳当看到一战的电影里出现袋鼠。

src: Don't go!
I'm sorry.
I'm so sorry!
Look!
This guy fell asleep!
He fell asleep too!
Be mad at him!
Or, call an ambulance.
Yes, and it is my dying wish to have that ring.
ref: 对，我临死前想拥有那枚戒指。

src: See, if I'm not buried with that ring then my spirit is going to wander the nether world for all eternity
ref: 看，如果我不能戴着它入土我会变成冤鬼，永世不去投胎。

src: Okay, that's enough honey!
I don't know. Let me see the ring.
ref: 我不晓得。再让我看一次。

src: Great!Okay, here.
All right.
Thank you. Thank you. Thank you!
What've you been up to?
Oh, you know, the usual, teaching aerobics, partying way too much.
ref: 还是老样子，教健美操，整天参加派对。

src: Oh, and in case you were wondering, those are my legs on the new James Bond poster.
ref: 我还要告诉你，新007电影海报上那双腿是我的。

src: Can you hold on a moment? I have another call. I love her.
ref: 你等我一下。有另一通电话打进来。我爱她。

src: I'm back.
So, are we gonna get together or what?
ref: 那我们到底要不要聚一聚？

src: Um, absolutely. Uh, how about tomorrow afternoon? Do you know uh, Central Perk in the Village, say, five-ish?
ref: 当然要。明天下午怎么样？知道格林威治村的中央公园咖啡馆吗？五点左右？

src: Great, I'll see you then.
Ok. Ok. Having a phone has finally paid off.
ref: 好的。不错。这电话装的值了。

src: I'm hoping that when Bob doesn't show up, she will seek comfort in the open arms of the wry stranger at the next table.
ref: 我只希望当她知道鲍勃放她鸽子的时候，她会投向邻桌陌生人的怀抱。

src: Ok, pure evil, horny and alone. I've done this
ref: 坏到骨子里，欲求不满。我试过后者。

src: Nobody!
Nobody respects the bucket!
ref: 没有人尊重我的募捐桶！

src: You wouldn't believe what people put in here!
ref: 这些烂人什么都往里扔！

src: Look!
Okay, does this look like a garbage can to you?
ref: 好吧，你觉得这个看起来像是垃圾桶吗？

src: No.
All right, you know what? We really are late!Let's go!Let's go!Let's go!!
ref: 说真的，真的迟到了！快走！快走！快走！！

src: Here you go Phoebe!Here you go Phobo!Phewbedo!Phaybobo.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Oh, do you need a hug? You don't have to bring me anything!
ref: 你要抱抱吗？你不必帮我拿东西！

src: Hey!
That's great, but shouldn't you be on the toilet right now?
ref: 太好了，但你现在不应该去蹲马桶吗？

src: What's wrong with you?
This sounds like a hernia. You have to you go to the doctor!
ref: 听起来像是疝气。你得去看医生！

src: That's a hernia.
I love your place!Where is this guy from?
ref: 我喜欢你家！这玩意从哪里来的？

src: Oh wow!So, you're more than just dinosaurs.
ref: 原来你不只喜欢研究恐龙。

src: Okay
Really?!
You don't think this is too fast.
ref: 你不觉得发展得太快了吗？

src: Ross, can I talk to you for a minute?
ref: 罗斯，我可以跟你谈谈吗？

src: Uh, well... Joey and I broke up.
Joey is a great guy, but we're just... so different!I mean, during your speech he kept laughing at homo erectus!
ref: 乔伊是个好男人，但是我们就是……我们很不一样了！就像是在你演讲的时候他一直在笑"直立人"！

src: Anyway I just, uh, I think it's for the best.
ref: 反正，我只是，我想这样是最好的。

src: I guess.
There was hum... there was another reason that I thought it was time to end it with Joey.
ref: 还有另外一个原因让我跟乔伊分手的。

src: I started to realize that I was having feelings for someone else.
ref: 我开始发觉我对另外一个人有感觉。

src: Ok Geller. Last day of the conference, you know what happens to the keynote speaker.
ref: 好的，盖勒。研讨会的最后一天了，你知道主讲人会被怎样的。

src: Yeah, can you guys just throw him in the pool later?
ref: 不能等会再丢他进游泳池吗？

src: Or we could throw you both in now.
ref: 或是把你们俩都丢进去。

src: Oy!!
What's with all this sand?
Oh, yeah, Bob said there might be flood damage.
ref: 是啊，鲍伯说可能淹过水。

src: If you said, "Big lima bean, bubbling up." Would she understand the difference?
ref: 若你说"吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮。"她会不会比较懂？

src: Rach? What are you doing?
It's a diaper commercial.
Pizza delivery!
Hi!
Hey!
Yay!!Oh so, you're not, you're not mad at us anymore?
ref: 耶！！因此你不再生我们气啦？

src: Didn't you sleep together?
How does she do that?
Would you look at her? She is so peaceful.
Oh!What what what!
What's going on with you?
I got no sleep last night!
My grandmother has this new boyfriend, and they're both kind of insecure in bed.
ref: 我奶奶交了一个新男友，他俩在床上翻来覆去。

src: Oh, and deaf.
So they're constantly, like, having to reassure each other that they're having a good time.
ref: 于是两人一直不断地互相确认对方是否尽兴。

src: You have no idea how loud they are!
Well, if you want, you can stay with Rachel and me tonight.
ref: 如果你愿意，今晚可以跟我和瑞秋睡。

src: Thanks.
It's just her water breaking. Calm down, will you?
ref: 只是她的羊水破了。冷静点行吗？

src: Breathe, breathe.
Are you insane? I mean Joey, is going to kill you, he's actually going to kill you dead.
ref: 你疯了不成？乔伊会杀了你，他真的会把你杀得死死的。

src: Okay!You don't think I thought of that?
How can you not know which one?
ref: 你怎么会不知道是哪一个？

src: I mean, was it Gina?
No, that's not Gina, that's Dina.
You see? You can't tell which one is which either, dwha!!
ref: 看到没？你们也分不清谁是谁！！

src: I know, we did it!!Hey, that was incredible, huh?!
ref: 我知道，太棒了！！嘿，太不可思议了，哈？！

src: Thank you, listen, thanks a lot Tribbiani,. Oh my God, look at the time, I gotta catch the bus to the ball.
ref: 崔比亚尼，谢谢，真是谢了。糟糕，都几点了，我得赶公车去舞会。

src: Yeah.
Ahh, thanks but no. You see I think I'm ready to dance with girls.
ref: 谢谢，不用了。我已经可以跟女生跳了。

src: Yeah.
Right. Hey, ahh, you wanna come? Marge has a girlfriend.
ref: 好。你想去吗？玛姬会带个朋友。

src: Yeah, you could dance real good with her, she's the same size as me.
ref: 你会很习惯，她跟我差不多壮。

src: Is it a good sign that they asked us to hang around after the audition?
ref: 我们在试镜之后被留下来，这是好现象吗？

src: Okay uh, we have narrowed it down to Raymond, Ben, Kyle, and Joey. The rest of you, thank you very much.
ref: 最后入围的是雷蒙、本、凯尔和乔伊。其余的人，辛苦了谢谢。

src: Actually, that can't happen.
Yeah because you all have such different looks, we're putting you with Raymond and Kyle with Ben.
ref: 因为你们长得太不像了，所以你和雷蒙一组，凯尔和本是一组。

src: So it'll be either you two or you two.
Okay, come on, I can't get married until I get something old, something new, something borrowed, and something blue.
ref: 快点，得凑齐四样东西，旧的新的借的蓝的，我们才能结婚。

src: Okay, all right, all right!Okay!Okay, here's something, here's something blue and new.
ref: 好的，好吧，好吧！好的！好的，这是蓝色的，而且也是新的。

src: I think you've got concussion.
You're welcome. I'm sorry. Did I hurt you?
Wow!That Mike thing was interesting!I don't know what's gonna happen with Phoebe and David.
ref: 迈克那件事真是有趣！我不知道菲比跟大卫之间会发生什么事。

src: I do!Want a hint? huh? "I do" "I do".
ref: 我知道！想要个提示吗？“我知道”“我知道”。

src: Ok, I'm sensing that this is some kind of word play, because you are pink with barely controlled glee.
ref: 好的，我可以感到这是什么文字游戏的，因为你已经有点无法控制的兴奋发红了。

src: David is going to propose to Phoebe.
What? Why?
Chandler, we have talked about this.
ref: 钱德勒，我们已经谈过了。

src: You are not supposed to give people advice!
ref: 你不可以给别人建议的！

src: Now couldn't you just have made some sort of inappropriate joke?
ref: 你不能说一些什么不适宜的笑话就好了吗？

src: I did!
They've only been going out for a few weeks and Phoebe is completely hung up on Mike!
ref: 他们才交往几个星期而已，菲比还无法忘记迈克！

src: She'll say "No", David's heart will be broken, it will be too hard for them to recover from and then Phoebe will end up alone again.
ref: 我想她会拒绝的，然后大卫会心碎，他们会很难复，菲比最后又落得孤零零一个人。

src: Man, that's some bad advice.
This is my father, Paul Stevens. Dad, this is Ross Geller.
ref: 这是我爸，保罗·史提芬斯。爸，这是罗斯·盖勒。

src: I usually prefer Elizabeth's boyfriends to address me as Mr. Stevens.
ref: 我喜欢伊丽莎白的男友叫我史提芬斯先生。

src: So Ross, what your problem?
Why can't you get a girlfriend your own age?
ref: 为什么交不到年龄相近的女友？

src: I don't like you going out with my daughter, Ross.
ref: 我不喜欢你跟我女儿交往，罗斯。

src: Okay.
Okay. I'll give you one chance to change my mind. You got one minute.
ref: 好。我给你个机会来改变我的看法。给你一分钟。

src: Daddy!
Well, then it's not on the wall yet.
So umm, now do you have any of Matt Lauer's clothes here? Maybe? Just ones that haven't been cleaned yet?
ref: 你手边有麦特·劳尔的衣服吗？有可能吗？就是还没洗过的那种？

src: Oh, my God. Are you sure?
Oh yeah, I'm sure. And all of a sudden his hands weren't the problem anymore.
ref: 是的，我确定。突然间他的手就不再是问题了。

src: Was it...?
Oh, boy scouts could have camped under there.
ref: 童子军都可以在那里扎营了。

src: Uma Thurman.
Oh!
So what are you gonna do?
Oh, yeah, you have to tell her.
She is gonna hate me.
Will you marry me?
Yeah, right here in my pocket. Pheebs?
Oh!What...?
Okay, now will you guys get out of here? I want this is to be a surprise and she's gonna know.
ref: 麻烦你们出去？我想给她惊喜，你们在这会露馅的。

src: Hi guys.
You are beautiful.
Oh, thank you!What's going on?
I can't believe it!
I did it!
I rode a bike!
I never thought I'd be able to do that!
Thank you Ross.
Thanks man.
What a baby.
Okay, we have a lot of options here, a number of prototypes for you to try on.
ref: 我们有多种选择，有好几种"鸡"型可以试戴。

src: Yeah!Okay, this one is a mushroom cap. Umm, this one is made of bologna.
ref: 是啊！这是磨菇帽。这是意大利香肠做的。

src: You kissed another woman!
Call it even?!
Okay!
Wait you stole those from these people's wedding?
ref: 那是你从人家婚礼上偷的吗？

src: Oh my God!!
Happy?!Is that what I'm supposed to be, Vic? Happy?
ref: 开心？！我应该感到开心吗，维克？开心？

src: Tasty!I'm really starting to feel like you guys have a history, it's nice.
ref: 有意思！我开始觉得你们有渊源了，很好。

src: I have a question about this scene.
Yes?
Well, I don't understand why Adrienne's attracted to Victor.
ref: 我不理解爱德莉安为什么会喜欢维克多。

src: Peel the onion. First of all, he's good looking.
I think my character's gonna need a little bit more of reason than that.
ref: 我的角色需要更好的理由

src: It doesn't say that in the script.
I can't believe he taped the two of them having sex.
ref: 我不敢相信他录下他们做爱的经过。

src: you know who has a great video camera?
ref: 你知道谁家有很棒的摄影机吗？

src: Greg and Jenny?
Do you still wanna call them? I wanna call them.
ref: 你还想打电话给他们吗？我想打给他们。

src: Let's call them.
Hello? Eighth street deli?
Uh sorry, wrong number.
Here you go, baby.
Hello? It's the deli again!
I don't think this number's right!
ref: 我觉得这个电话号码是错的！

src: Gotta go. I miss you too, I love you, but it's getting real late now
ref: 我得挂了。我也想你，我爱你，但现在很晚了。

src: Her name's Ronni. She's a pet mortician.
ref: 她叫罗妮。她是宠物殡葬业者。

src: Remember when you were a little kid, I used to take you to the navy yard and show you the big ships?
ref: 记得你小时候，我常带你去海军军港看大船吗？

src: No, it's only been six years.
I just wanted to put a nice memory in your head, so you'd know that I wasn't always such a terrible guy.
ref: 我只想勾起你美好的回忆，让你觉得我并不一直是个大烂人。

src: Joe.
You ever been in love?
Then y'haven't. You're burning your tomatoes.
ref: 那就是没有。你的番茄烧焦了。

src: Joe, your dad's in love big time. And the worst part of it is, it's with two different women.
ref: 乔伊，你老爸爱得无法自拔。最糟的是我同时爱着两个女人。

src: Of course one of them's Ma. What's the matter with you?
ref: 当然其中一个是你妈。你是怎么搞的？

src: Everything's gonna be all right. Okay, Dick?
Hello, I am Guru Saj. That's supposed to be a duck right? Cause otherwise, this is way out of my league.
ref: 你们好，我是萨吉大师。他本来就是只鸭子吧？否则就远超出我的能力范围了。

src: Hey, Rach, how was work?
By the way, Ross dropped by a box of your stuff.
ref: 对了，罗斯拿了一盒你的东西来。

src: Something wrong?
And then, and then you said that thing about, about bringing the Mesozoic era in the 21st century.
ref: 然后你开始谈到中生代世纪带到二十一世纪。

src: Yeah.
Nope, you're right, it is a ridiculous name!
ref: 不，你说得对，这个名字太可笑了！

src: Yes it is!From now on, I have no first name.
ref: 当然有！从此以后，我不要名了。

src: Because we won our apartment back!
ref: 我们把这套公寓赢回来了！

src: No!Ace is low!Ace, two, three, four!
I don't know. Ooh!Ooh!Look it!Ah-ha!
ref: 我不知道。哦！哦！你们看！啊哈！

src: Yeah baby!
But, we pick again!We pick again!
I don't know!
Tickets please!That's courtside baby!
No, they didn't!
You know, I don't think we brought enough stuff. Did you forget to pack the baby's anvil?
ref: 我觉得我们东西没有带够。你是不是忘带宝宝的止痛贴片了？

src: No, I got him.
Oh, seriously you want him?
Well, don't, don't think me immodest, but, me?
ref: 不是我脸皮厚，但真是，我？

src: Well, we are great guys.
Well Ross, you be careful now. You don't want to get a reputation as you know Professor McNails-his-students.
ref: 罗斯，还是小心为上。你也不想被人取绰号叫"泡学生叫兽"。

src: Joey, that is so sweet.
Hey.
I couldn't do it.
Hey, relax I just need more time. We're going to dinner tonight.
ref: 我需要更多时间。我们晚上会跟她吃饭。

src: What?!You're going out with her again!
Uh, Dana Keystone, from college.
No, that was Dana Caplin.
Joey!You didn't even know her!
Don't touch him!
I know.
Ooh, I have to tell you something.
What?
But I can't tell you.
Okay, but wouldn't it be easier if you had to tell me something that you could tell me.
ref: 好吧，那你挑能告诉我的事情说不是更好吗。

src: Well, sure in a perfect world. But, no, I promised I wouldn't tell, and I swore to like all my gods.
ref: 是呀。哪有那么好的事情，可不行，我答应不说，我对所有神明发过誓。

src: Okay. Does it have to do with Ross and Rachel?
ref: 好吧。跟罗斯和瑞秋有关吗？

src: No.
Does it have to do with Joey?
No.
Does it have to do with Chandler and that sock that he keeps by his bed?
ref: 跟钱德勒和他床边的袜子有关吗？

src: No, but let's come back to that later!
ref: 不是，不过你等下你要给我讲讲！

src: Hi!
Richard!
Actually, I'm not here to complement the chef.
ref: 其实我不是来向主厨致意的。

src: Ohh Oh, that's okay I hate when people come back to complement the chef.
ref: 没关系，我最讨厌客人跑来致意。

src: Like I have nothing better to do!
So what's up?
Well, it was great seeing you the other night.
ref: 那天晚上遇见你很开心。

src: Oh, good to see you too. Did you come down here to tell me that?
ref: 我也很开心。你就是来说这个的吗？

src: No!I came here to tell you something else. I came here to tell you I still love you.
ref: 不是！我是来说别的。我是来说我仍然爱你。

src: Joey, I am scared to death about this.
ref: 乔伊，这件事真的让我很害怕。

src: But I really think I can do it, I'm just gonna need some help.
ref: 但我想我办得到，我只是需要帮助。

src: And Bobby's gonna be here the whole time.
You bet I am!And to answer your earlier question, we're straight-up gangster rap.
ref: 没错！至于你刚刚问的那个问题，我们唱纯粹的匪帮说唱。

src: Look, Rachel's told me how much easier you've made all this on her. Why can't you do that for me?
ref: 瑞秋告诉我你一直都很支持她。你为什么不能支持我？

src: And you're my big brother!
I mean, you're my favorite guy in the whole world.
ref: 你是我全世界最喜欢的人。

src: I'm not even scared to tell mom and dad.
ref: 我甚至不怕告诉妈妈跟爸爸。

src: I was scared of telling you.
Joey, I can't stand the thought of having this baby with you mad at me.
ref: 乔伊，想到你会因为我怀孕而生我的气，我就受不了。

src: I want him to have his uncle.
Is my baby gonna have his Uncle Joey?
ref: 我的宝宝会有乔伊舅舅吗？

src: We're gonna be all right. I mean, even if we're not married this baby is gonna be so loved. Not just by us.
ref: 我们会没事的。即使我们没结婚，宝宝还是会得到宠爱。不只是我们会爱他。

src: And by you.
I had a really nice time tonight.
I'd love to ask you in, but uh, my sister's visiting and I think she's asleep on the couch.
ref: 我很想请你进去，不过我妹来看我，她可能睡在沙发上。

src: Oh hey, great, you're up. Rachel, this is my sister Krista. Krista, this is Rachel.

ref: 抱歉，只是在菲比眼中，你的魅力是没有男性吸引力的。

src: Oh, you know I can't hear that enough.
I'm sorry, I think that you just misunderstood her.
ref: 抱歉，你应该误解她的意思了。

src: No, I didn't misunderstand, okay? She was all over me!She touched my bicep for crying out loud!
ref: 我没有误解，好吗？她对我上下其手！她还摸我的二头肌呢！

src: This bicep?
Well it's not flexed right now!
It's Phoebe.
Umm, well I sorta have some bad news, can I come in?
ref: 有个坏消息，我可以进去吗？

src: Umm, well, umm Grandma died.
No, she just died today!Okay, umm, we're having a memorial service tomorrow.
ref: 不是，她今天刚死！明天我们会举行追悼会。

src: No you didn't!
Well, lots of people!Look, are you coming to memorial service or not?
ref: 很多人！说吧，你到底来不来参加追悼会？

src: Fine. Okay, enjoy your concert.
ref: 好吧。好吧，好好享受你的演唱会。

src: anyway, his name is Allan and we've been going out for three years.
ref: 话说回来，他叫艾伦，我们在一起三年了。

src: He was my first client when I became a party planner.
ref: 他是我做宴会策划的第一位客户。

src: He was planning a party for his girlfriend at the time.
ref: 那时他正要给他女朋友策划宴会。

src: Oh well.
And he was Theta Beta Pi at Syracuse.
ref: 他是雪城大学贝塔兄弟会的。

src: Really? Like how?
That's a good one.
Yeah, you're funny.
Can I do it to you?
Is this about me taking your watch?
ref: 是因为我拿走你的手表吗？

src: I'm sorry, I do that.
Oh no. I feel it isn't really anybody's business, you know.
ref: 没有。我觉得不关别人的事，你知道的。

src: Oh, one other thing. Hoshi thinks that you being ringside may have affected my concentration.
ref: 还有一件事。保志认为你在场边，会影响我的注意力。

src: Yeah. That was the problem.
Excuse me, Doug? Hey there sports fan!!
ref: 打扰一下，道格？喂，超级运动迷！！

src: Bing!You got those numbers for me?
So you still in touch with anyone from high school?
ref: 你还有跟哪些同学联络？

src: Umm. Well, there's Rachel, and umm, I think that's it. How bout you?
ref: 有瑞秋，还有嗯，就这样。你呢？

src: Oh yeah, I still hang with Simmons and Zana, you know.
ref: 我还在跟西门斯、萨纳混。

src: I see Spindler a lot. Devane, Kelly
ref: 也常跟史宾、莱文、凯利见面。

src: and I run into Goldie from time to time.
Steve Brown, Sulkov, McGuire, J.T., Beardsley.
ref: 史迪、布朗、苏卡夫、麦奎尔。

src: Is that all?
Ehh, you know after high school, you just kinda lose touch. Oh yeah!I ran into Richard Dorfman.
ref: 毕了业都会失去联络，我有遇见李察多夫曼。

src: Ohh, how is he?
Not so good, Simmons and I gave him a wedgie.
ref: 不太好，被我和西门斯敲竹杠。

src: Isn't he an architect now?
Yeah, they still wear underwear.
ref: 是的，建筑师也要穿内裤。

src: But you found the keys to his clothes?
ref: 但你捡到了他的衣橱钥匙吗？

src: And people will think you own a Porsche because you're wearing the clothes?
ref: 别人会因为你穿着这样而觉得你有保时捷吗？

src: I'm not even getting married!Okay, this is a question for science fiction writers!
ref: 我都没有要结婚！这个问题应该由科幻小说作家来回答！

src: I'm not even I'm not even
Umm, slight change of plans. We've shut down.
ref: 计划有些改变。我们停拍了。

src: It's a money thing, we don't have any.
No.
It's probably just temporary. We're hoping to get some more money soon, so if could just uh, hang out.
ref: 这或许只是暂时的。我们希望能快点筹到资金，你先撑一下。

src: I don't know.
A week?
Maybe two?
The money will turn up!
People will always wanna invest in movies!
Hey, you're not rich are you?
Eh, worth a shot. Look Joey, let me know where you're staying, okay?
ref: 问一下也无妨。乔伊，让我知道你在哪儿落脚？

src: Hey pal, are you Joey Tribbiani?
ref: 伙计，你是乔伊·崔比安尼吗？

src: These got left for you.
Rachel, do you have any muffins left?
Oh, you're busy, that's ok, I'll get it. Anybody else want one?
ref: 你太忙了，没关系，我去拿，还有谁要吗？

src: Hey.
Hey!
So how was Joan?
I broke up with her.
They were huge. When she sneezed, bats flew out of them.
ref: 真的超大。她打喷嚏时，会有蝙蝠飞出来。

src: I'm telling you, she leaned back; I could see her brain.
ref: 当她仰起头时，我可以看到她的脑子。

src: How many perfectly fine women are you gonna reject over the most superficial insignificant things?
ref: 你到底要因为非常肤浅的事情拒绝多少好女孩。

src: You or me?
Yeah. We are!
